sourceNotes: 首次发布独立 XStats Capture，无需安装 XStats 即可截图、编辑与录屏。
支持区域、窗口与整屏截图，提供标注、裁剪、马赛克和本机敏感信息识别。
支持系统声音与麦克风录制、暂停继续、首尾裁剪和 MP4 导出。
提供独立偏好设置与快捷键，并通过 Sparkle 检查和安装已签名更新。

en: First standalone release of XStats Capture: capture, annotate and record without installing XStats.
Capture a region, window or display, with annotations, cropping, pixelation and on-device sensitive information detection.
Record system audio and microphone input, pause and resume, trim the ends and export MP4 video.
Includes independent preferences and shortcuts, with Sparkle checks and installation of signed updates.
